series.title: Senate permitting bill would expand federal role in transmission siting
series.summary: The legislation gives FERC authority to issue permits for transmission projects when they are in the public interest. It also eliminates NIETCs and the federal right of first refusal for incumbent utilities and protects existing federal permits.
